3.text: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?

4.text: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].

5.text: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].

6.text: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming,<sup foot_note="228070">1</sup> violent wind

7.text: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

8.text: Then do you see of them any remains?

9.text: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities<sup foot_note="228071">1</sup> with sin.

footnotes.228071: - Those to which Lot was sent (see 11:82-83) or generally, all cities which were destroyed due to their denial of a messenger from Allāh.

10.text: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].

11.text: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship<sup foot_note="228072">1</sup>

12.text: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

13.text: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

14.text: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -

15.text: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,

16.text: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.<sup foot_note="228073">1</sup>

17.text: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].

18.text: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.<sup foot_note="228074">1</sup>

footnotes.228074: - i.e., any person or any secret you might attempt to conceal.

19.text: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!

20.text: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."

21.text: So he will be in a pleasant life -

23.text: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.

24.text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth<sup foot_note="228075">1</sup> in the days past."

footnotes.228075: - Literally, "advanced" in anticipation of reward in the Hereafter.

25.text: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

26.text: And had not known what is my account.

27.text: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.<sup foot_note="228076">1</sup>

footnotes.228076: - i.e., ending life rather than being the gateway to eternal life.

28.text: My wealth has not availed me.

29.text: Gone from me is my authority."<sup foot_note="228077">1</sup>

footnotes.228077: - i.e., I have no valid excuse to stand on.

30.text: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.

32.text: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."

33.text: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,

34.text: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

35.text: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

36.text: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;

37.text: None will eat it except the sinners.

38.text: So I swear by what you see

39.text: And what you do not see

40.text: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.

41.text: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.

42.text: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.

43.text: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

44.text: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,

45.text: We would have seized him by the right hand;<sup foot_note="228078">1</sup>

footnotes.228078: - Another interpretation is "by [Our] right hand," i.e., Allāh would have exacted revenge with might and power.

46.text: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.<sup foot_note="228079">1</sup>

47.text: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.

48.text: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.

49.text: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.

50.text: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.

51.text: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.

52.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
